name: WELLSTAR Technologies Corp.
summary: WELLSTAR Technologies Corp. operates as a healthcare technology company in Canada. The company offers electronic medical records software for primary care and specialist providers, AI-enabled digital health applications, patient engagement and eReferral solutions, billing and back-office services, and IT and practice management services; and digital health networks services. It also provides Nexus AI, which provides agentic AI solutions that automate complex healthcare workflows, and reducing cognitive load while improving patient care outcomes.
